### Run Operations
#### Python
_No operation description provided._
```python
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from lib.files import write_json
data = {{ data | tojson }}
write_json(Path("{{ path }}"), data)
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"path": "{{ path }}"}, f)
```
